Cc: procurement@sprouthealth.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to hold the pilot clock during procurement audit — temporary credit proposal

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the integration looked really promising and the Sprout team had great questions. I heard back from product about the scoped pilot and we want to avoid losing momentum while procurement runs their vendor audit.

If procurement needs additional time, we can provision a short-term, one-time sandbox credit to keep the pilot live so your engineers can continue internal validation. Proposed option: a 7-calendar-day buffer of 12,000 token-equivalent credits tied to the current pilot scope. No billing will occur unless a PO is issued.

Can you confirm (a) whether procurement has the documentation they need, (b) an estimated timeline for the audit/PO, and (c) whether your procurement contact will accept a temporary credit arrangement? I copied procurement here to keep it transparent.

I attached a short terms sheet for temporary credits (temporary_credit_terms.pdf) and a blank PO form (Sprout_PO_form.pdf) for your convenience.

If you prefer, we can make this a 3-day or 14-day buffer — let me know what would be most helpful.

Best,
David

Can you approve a one-time 7-day 12k token credit for Sprout? If yes I’ll send the formal note and draft quote and attach the requested checklist.

Thanks — this is time-sensitive; the pilot team is scheduled to demo to stakeholders next week.
